selection_rule: maximize minimum centered/varied success; full-task success secondary; mean single-pass success then lower full-task crash rate break remaining ties
seed_note: 4M is an additional reserved selection range, disjoint from known demonstration seeds starting at 1M and fixed evaluation seeds starting at 3M. Training initially used seed 0 and resets advance its RNG. Individual historical episode seeds were not logged, so zero historical overlap is not formally proven. Selection results are no longer untouched test data.
